extra_vocab.en: to go around something instead of going through it
extra_vocab.note: 原文雖然沒有直接出現這個字，但 work around those patents 的意思就接近 bypass：設計新機構來避開對手的專利。bypass 比 work around 更強調「直接繞開、略過」某個障礙或規定。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: bypass 當動詞時是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞（bypass the patent），不加 around 或 of。

example.en: This new mechanism bypasses the competitor's patent completely.
example.zh: 這個新機構完全繞開了競爭對手的專利。

example.en: The team bypassed the old software and built a new tool.
example.zh: 團隊略過舊軟體，自己做了一個新工具。

example.en: We saved time by bypassing the second round of approval.
example.zh: 我們略過第二輪核准，節省了時間。

example.en: The city built two bypasses to reduce traffic in the center.
example.zh: 市府蓋了兩條外環道來減少市中心的車流。

example.en: Managers should not bypass the approval process for large purchases.
example.zh: 大額採購時，主管不應該略過核准程序。

example.en: No one is allowed to bypass a security system in our building.
example.zh: 我們大樓裡任何人都不得繞過安全系統。

example.en: Engineers found a clever way to bypass a patent held by a rival.
example.zh: 工程師找到一個巧妙的方法，避開對手持有的專利。

examples.en: We want to bypass the patent issue by changing the mechanism.
examples.zh: 我們想透過改變機構來避開專利問題。

examples.en: Buying directly lets us bypass the distributor and lower our costs.
examples.zh: 直接購買讓我們略過經銷商，降低成本。

examples.en: Staff must not bypass the login page to open the company files.
examples.zh: 員工不得略過登入頁面去開啟公司檔案。

confusable.diff: pass by 是「路過、經過」，不是刻意避開；bypass 是為了避開而繞過。
confusable.usage: bypass 是一個字，後面直接接受詞；pass by 是片語，常寫成 pass by + 地點，也可單獨使用。

example.en: Please pass by my office after the meeting to pick up the files.
example.zh: 會議結束後，請順道來我辦公室拿檔案。

similar.diff: work around 多指想辦法解決問題或限制，語氣較口語；bypass 強調直接繞開或略過。

example.en: Engineers worked around the problem by using a different part.
example.zh: 工程師改用不同的零件來解決這個問題。

similar.diff: avoid 是「避免、不去碰」，範圍較廣；bypass 是指繞過某個障礙或步驟，仍要達到目標。

example.en: We should avoid using parts covered by the competitor's patent.
example.zh: 我們應該避免使用受競爭對手專利保護的零件。

example.en: We took a detour because the main road was closed.
example.zh: 因為主要道路封閉，我們繞道而行。

example.en: There is no shortcut to getting a safety approval.
example.zh: 取得安全核准沒有捷徑。

example.en: The IT team found a workaround until the update is ready.
example.zh: 在更新完成前，資訊團隊找到了變通辦法。

example.en: The new route will bypass the crowded city center.
example.zh: 新路線會繞過擁擠的市中心。

example.en: The bypass cuts our delivery time to the port by half an hour.
example.zh: 這條外環道讓我們到港口的運送時間縮短了半小時。

senses.en: to find a way around a problem or rule

example.en: They bypassed the supplier shortage by finding a new factory.
example.zh: 他們找到新工廠，避開了供應商缺貨的問題。

senses.en: to skip a person or step in a normal process
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人（經理、經銷商）或流程步驟時，多半是「略過、越過」。

example.en: She bypassed her manager and sent the request to the director.
example.zh: 她越過經理，直接把申請送給了主任。
